name: application-step-progress-sidebar
title: Step Progress Sidebar
description: A persistent vertical step nav for multi-page flows — completed steps show a checkmark, the current step is highlighted, upcoming steps are numbered and muted.
useWhen: A multi-step flow (onboarding, checkout, setup wizard) spans separate pages and benefits from a persistent, always-visible step list beside the content.
Users may want to jump back to a completed step, which a persistent sidebar nav supports better than a top-only progress bar.
avoidWhen: The flow is a single page with inline sections — a horizontal `Stepper Wizard` header is more compact and doesn't need a dedicated sidebar column.
Steps must be completed strictly in order with no jumping back — a simple linear progress bar communicates that constraint more directly.
responsiveBehavior: The step list is a fixed-width sidebar beside the flex-1 step content; collapse to a horizontal step bar above the content on narrow viewports instead of shrinking the sidebar further.
accessibility: The step list is wrapped in <nav aria-label="..."> with an ordered list (<ol>), since step order is meaningful.
The current step carries aria-current="step" in addition to its visual highlight (raised card, ring, dark badge).
Completed steps pair a checkmark icon with the completed state — icon plus position, not color alone — so screen readers relying on DOM order still get sequence information.

variants.title: Onboarding steps
variants.description: A five-step onboarding sidebar: two completed steps (checkmarks), the current step (raised card, dark badge, aria-current), and two upcoming muted steps, beside a matching form pane.
accessibility: The current step carries aria-current="step"; completed steps show a checkmark icon, not color alone.

variants.title: Onboarding steps (Dark)
variants.description: Step progress sidebar adapted for dark surfaces, including the completed-step checkmark color and current-step highlight.
accessibility: Step badges and labels meet WCAG AA contrast at every state against the dark sidebar background.
